title.en: Market, limit, cancel: what does each one solve?
title.zh-Hans: 市价、限价、撤单，分别解决什么问题？

open_visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第14集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。

shots.visual_en: Sam places a buy below the current price, waits a moment, and decides the system is broken.
shots.visual_zh: 小白挂了低于现价的买单，等了片刻就以为系统坏了。

text.en: I hit Buy. Why isn't it filling?
text.zh-Hans: 我按了买入，为什么一直不成交？

shots.source_visual_zh: 小白挂了低于现价的买单，等了片刻就以为系统坏了。

shots.visual_en: Two order cards. Market: 'fills at the best available prices'. Limit: 'sets the price you'll accept'.
shots.visual_zh: 两张订单卡：市价“优先按可成交报价执行”；限价“设定可接受价格边界”。

text.en: A market order tries to fill quickly at the prices available now, but the final price can move. A limit order says 'buy no higher' or 'sell no lower' than a set price. It isn't guaranteed to fill.
text.zh-Hans: 市价单倾向于尽快按当前可用报价成交，但最终价格可能变化。限价单规定买入不超过、卖出不低于某个价格，不保证成交。

shots.source_visual_zh: 两张订单卡：市价“优先按可成交报价执行”；限价“设定可接受价格边界”。

shots.visual_en: Current buy price 50,000; Sam places a buy at 49,000; the order joins a waiting queue.
shots.visual_zh: 当前可买价格50,000，小白挂49,000买单，订单进入等待队列。
shots.onscreen_text_zh-Hans: 低于市价 → 可能要等

text.en: If you want to buy below the current price, you may have to wait. On the other hand, a limit order that already meets the other side's price can fill right away. Not every limit order has to wait in line.
text.zh-Hans: 想低于当前价格买，就可能需要等待。反过来，限价单若已经满足对手盘条件，也可能立即成交，不是每张限价单都只能排队。

shots.source_visual_zh: 当前可买价格50,000，小白挂49,000买单，订单进入等待队列。

en: Teaching assumption · not a live price or real platform rate
zh-Hans: 教学假设 · 非实时行情，非平台真实费率

shots.visual_en: The order fills 40% first; Cancel removes only the remaining 60%; the filled part stays on the assets page.
shots.visual_zh: 订单先成交40%，撤单按钮只消除剩余60%，已成交部分留在资产页。

text.en: So does cancelling undo what I already bought?
text.zh-Hans: 那撤单是不是把刚才买的也撤掉？

text.en: No. Cancel only affects the part that hasn't filled. What already filled stays. It doesn't rewind.
text.zh-Hans: 不是。撤单只处理尚未成交的部分；已经成交的资产变化不会被倒放。

shots.source_visual_zh: 订单先成交40%，撤单按钮只消除剩余60%，已成交部分留在资产页。

shots.visual_en: Order statuses: Open, Partly filled, Filled, Cancelled; beside them: 'A limit order doesn't guarantee the maker fee'.
shots.visual_zh: 订单状态分为待成交、部分成交、已成交、已撤销；并列“挂单并非保证挂单费率”。

text.en: Read the status before you act. Whether you're the maker or the taker depends on how the trade actually filled. Choosing 'limit' doesn't automatically get you a certain fee.
text.zh-Hans: 看清状态再操作。是否属于挂单方或吃单方，要看实际成交方式；并不是选择限价，就必定得到某一种费率。

note.zh-Hans: 限价 ≠ 保证挂单费率

shots.source_visual_zh: 订单状态分为待成交、部分成交、已成交、已撤销；并列“挂单并非保证挂单费率”。

zh-Hans: 限价 ≠ 保证挂单费率

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'A limit buy at 49,000, and the market stays above it. Will it definitely fill?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：49,000的买入限价单，市场一直高于它，会一定成交吗？

text.en: Choosing an order type is choosing how it executes. It's not making a wish.
text.zh-Hans: 选订单是在选择执行方式，不是在许愿。

question.en: A limit buy at 49,000, and the market stays above it. Will it definitely fill?
question.zh-Hans: 限价 49,000 买入，市价一直在上方，一定会成交吗？

shots.source_visual_zh: 题目：49,000的买入限价单，市场一直高于它，会一定成交吗？

zh-Hans: 限价 49,000，市场一直更高 → 成交？ 不会

text.en: A green candle. Does it mean the next one goes up too? Next episode.
text.zh-Hans: 绿色蜡烛，是不是代表下一根也会涨？下一集。

text.en: A green candle. Does it mean the next one goes up too? Next episode.
text.zh-Hans: 绿色蜡烛，是不是代表下一根也会涨？下一集。

end_hook.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

close_visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
close_visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

goal.en: Choose an order by 'fill first' or 'price limit first', and understand unfilled and partly filled orders.
goal.zh-Hans: 会根据成交优先或价格边界选择订单，并理解未成交和部分成交。

page_cta.line_en: Order types and maker/taker fees differ by exchange. Compare them on NexuAlpha.
page_cta.line_zh: 各交易所的订单类型和挂单/吃单费用不同，到 NexuAlpha 对比页查看。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Place a virtual limit order, watch it partly fill, then cancel the remaining quantity.
exercise.task_zh: 放置虚拟限价单、观察部分成交，再撤销剩余数量。
exercise.answer_en: Even at a suitable price, filling depends on available quantity and more. A cancel can't reverse what already filled.
exercise.answer_zh: 价格条件合适也受可成交数量等因素影响；已成交部分不能被撤单逆转。

red_lines: Never promise a market order always fills completely ｜ 不承诺市价必定全部成交
Never say a limit order can never fill immediately ｜ 不把限价单说成永远不会立即成交
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
